items.question: 어제 순 방문자 수는?
최근 7일 일별 페이지뷰 추이를 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date,
    SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 최근 30일 동안 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    event_name,
    SUM(event_count) AS total_events
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 30
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY total_events DESC;

items.question: 지난주 페이지뷰가 가장 많은 페이지 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    page_path,
    SUM(page_views) AS page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY page_path
ORDER BY page_views DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 이탈률(%)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    ROUND(SUM(bounced_sessions)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS bounce_rate_percent
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY bounce_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 14일 기기 유형별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC;

items.question: 이번 달 결제 완료 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) AS payment_count
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
  AND summary_date <= current_date;

items.question: 어제 성별 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    gender,
    SUM(users) AS visitor_count
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

items.question: 최근 7일 연령대별 평균 세션 시간(초)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
    age_group,
    (SUM(session_duration_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0)) AS average_session_duration_seconds
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

items.question: 지난주 시간대(0~23시)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  summary_hour AS hour,
  SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY summary_hour
ORDER BY summary_hour;

items.question: 최근 7일 nov_mega_sale 캠페인의 유입 소스·매체별 세션 수와 전환 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    traffic_medium,
    SUM(sessions)      AS sessions,
    SUM(conversions)   AS conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date <  current_date
  AND traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 7일 페이지뷰 100회 이상인 페이지 중 평균 체류 시간(초)이 가장 긴 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    page_path,
    SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
    SUM(time_on_page_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS average_time_on_page_seconds
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY page_path
HAVING SUM(page_views) >= 100
ORDER BY average_time_on_page_seconds DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 15일 전 기기 유형별로 /checkout/success 페이지를 본 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type AS device_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 15
  AND timestamp < current_date - 14
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND page_path = '/checkout/success'
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH last_week AS (
    SELECT traffic_source,
           SUM(sessions) AS sessions_last_week
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7)
      AND summary_date <  date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
), this_week AS (
    SELECT traffic_source,
           SUM(sessions) AS sessions_this_week
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      AND summary_date <= current_date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT COALESCE(l.traffic_source, t.traffic_source)      AS traffic_source,
       COALESCE(l.sessions_last_week, 0)                AS sessions_last_week,
       COALESCE(t.sessions_this_week, 0)                AS sessions_this_week,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(l.sessions_last_week, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE (COALESCE(t.sessions_this_week, 0) - COALESCE(l.sessions_last_week, 0)) * 100.0
                / l.sessions_last_week
       END                                            AS sessions_change_percent
FROM   last_week l
FULL   OUTER JOIN this_week t USING (traffic_source)
ORDER  BY sessions_this_week DESC
LIMIT  1000;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    traffic_medium,
    SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
    SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions,
    ROUND(SUM(conversions)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100
ORDER BY conversion_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    summary_date,
    SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
  AVG(total_sessions) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY iso_weekday
ORDER BY iso_weekday;

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.reason: events 테이블을 조회할 때는 WHERE 절에 timestamp 기간 조건이 필요합니다. 일 단위 이상 집계는 agg_* 테이블을 우선 사용하세요.
items.sql:
WITH session_starts AS (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        MIN(timestamp) AS session_start,
        MIN(device_type) AS device_type
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp < current_date
    GROUP BY session_id
    HAVING MIN(timestamp) >= current_date - interval '7 days'
       AND MIN(timestamp) < current_date
),
payment_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        ss.device_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.session_id) AS payment_sessions
    FROM session_starts ss
    JOIN events e
      ON e.session_id = ss.session_id
     AND e.event_name = 'is_payment'
     AND e.timestamp >= current_date - interval '7 days'
     AND e.timestamp < current_date
    GROUP BY ss.device_type
),
total_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        device_type,
        SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.device_type, p.device_type) AS device_type,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(p.payment_sessions, 0)::numeric * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(t.total_sessions, 0), 0),
        2
    ) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM total_sessions t
FULL OUTER JOIN payment_sessions p
  ON t.device_type = p.device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(daily_visitors)::numeric
   FROM (
     SELECT summary_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_visitors
     FROM agg_daily_users
     WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
       AND summary_date < current_date
     GROUP BY summary_date
   ) AS recent) AS recent_7day_avg_visitors,
  (SELECT AVG(daily_visitors)::numeric
   FROM (
     SELECT summary_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_visitors
     FROM agg_daily_users
     WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
       AND summary_date < current_date - 7
     GROUP BY summary_date
   ) AS previous) AS previous_7day_avg_visitors;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
    SELECT
        event_name,
        SUM(event_count) AS this_week_events
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      AND summary_date <= current_date
    GROUP BY event_name
), last_week AS (
    SELECT
        event_name,
        SUM(event_count) AS last_week_events
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.event_name, l.event_name) AS event_name,
    COALESCE(t.this_week_events, 0)      AS this_week_events,
    COALESCE(l.last_week_events, 0)      AS last_week_events,
    COALESCE(t.this_week_events, 0) - COALESCE(l.last_week_events, 0) AS diff_events,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.last_week_events, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((COALESCE(t.this_week_events, 0) - COALESCE(l.last_week_events, 0))::numeric
              / COALESCE(l.last_week_events, 0) * 100.0)
    END AS pct_change
FROM this_week t
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week l USING (event_name)
ORDER BY event_name
LIMIT 1000;
